verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official MCP server is documented on Airwallex's AgentOS page. First-party docs describe AgentOS as a toolkit that lets AI agents act on a production Airwallex account (reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards), and separate developer connectors that link coding agents like Cursor and Claude Code to the docs and sandbox. Missing for 10: verbatim MCP protocol and setup details (transport, auth flow, tool list), and independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Airwallex AgentOS is a toolkit for AI agents that need to act on your production Airwallex account — reading balances, creating beneficiaries, issuing cards, building cashflow reports
The Airwallex developer connectors connects AI coding agents — Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools — to Airwallex documentation and the Airwallex sandbox.
